routes.name: Free entry visa for GCC and Jordanian citizens
routes.summary: Citizens of Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, UAE, Bahrain, Qatar and Oman get a free 6 month visa stamped at the airport or border. Jordanians get 3 months. Free extension to one year.

other: Maids, drivers and bodyguards travel under their employer's sponsorship and need a valid residency permit from the employer's country.
Jordanians with a national-number passport get a free multiple-entry 6 month visa if entering for professional reasons.

stay.note: 6 months for GCC, 3 months for Jordan. Extendable to one year.

routes.name: Free 1 month visa for listed countries
routes.summary: Citizens of about 80 listed countries (US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia, Russia, China, Japan, Gulf-adjacent and Caucasus states and more) get a free 1 month visa on arrival, extendable to 3 months. Report your address to General Security.

other: Women aged 17 to 45 from Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bulgaria, China, Croatia, Czechia, Estonia, Georgia, Hong Kong, Hungary, Kyrgyzstan, Latvia, Lithuania, Macau, North Macedonia, Moldova, Montenegro, Poland, Russia, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Tajikistan, Ukraine, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan need a non-refundable round-trip ticket and a hotel booking or clear address, unless they have prior authorization.
Female artists and masseuses need prior authorization.
Emergency passports from some countries still qualify for the visa on arrival.

routes.name: Visa from embassy or prior authorization
routes.summary: If your country isn't on a free list, you need a visa from a Lebanese embassy or prior authorization from General Security. Nigeria, Ghana and Ivory Coast groups also need pre-approval. The page also covers other entry reasons that need prior approval.

other: Typical documents: hotel booking or address, plane ticket, bank statement or credit card, and proof of job or income.
Documents must be in Arabic, French or English. Submitting everything does not guarantee approval.
Visit visas are generally not renewable and cannot be converted to work visas without a director general decision.
Fees and validity are not stated on the page.

routes.name: Business and investor visa
routes.summary: Arab first-time investors and businessmen, and others such as bankers, directors, patients of Lebanese origin and tour groups of 8 or more, can get a free 6 month visa at the airport or border. Investors need an IDAL invitation or home-country attestation. Businessmen need a Lebanese host's invitation.

other: Investors: IDAL invitation or official attestation.
Businessmen: invitation from a Lebanese host, proof of accommodation, and a certified commercial register copy. Processed within 72 hours.
The page says this applies to Arab first-time investors and businessmen. Other nationalities were not confirmed.

routes.name: Work visa
routes.summary: Needs prior approval from General Security and the Ministry of Labor. Work residency is handled separately after entry.

other: Two General Security pages give different validity (3 months on one, 1 month renewable once on the other). Confirm with General Security.
Work residency categories (grace period, annual, permanent) exist but details were not confirmed.
Artists and others seeking work need prior authorization.

routes.name: Six-month multiple-entry residence based on a bank statement
routes.summary: A 6 month multiple-entry residency for people with a large balance in a Lebanese bank. You cannot work.

savings.note: Minimum balance in a Lebanese bank account, or the foreign currency equivalent at the Sayrafa rate, with a bank statement for the last 3 months.

other: Open to Arab and foreign nationals. Only the account holder can apply.
Notarized declaration that you will not do paid work.
Not available to people ordered to leave Lebanon or holders of a work residence permit.
A service fee applies. Amount not stated on this page.

steps: Apply at a General Security regional center with a request to the Director General.
documents: Valid ID plus two certified color copies

routes.name: Student visa and residency
routes.summary: Arab students get a free 3 month entry visa with an admission or enrollment certificate. Foreign students are granted under country-specific conditions. Religious students need prior authorization requested by their institution.

other: Arab students: student card and admission or enrollment certificate.
Religious studies students: aged 18+, institution requests prior authorization from General Security, apply 1 month before the academic year. Some nationalities are temporarily excluded.
Children of married religious students do not get their own residency.
Proof of sufficient funds applies unless on a grant or scholarship.

stay.note: Entry visa 3 months for Arab students. Religious student residency is multiple entry, 3 months, requested once a year.

routes.name: Volunteer, missionary and clergy visa
routes.summary: Needs a request from a religious or charitable institution or a university. It is treated as a tourist visa and cannot be turned into residency. Staying longer needs prior General Security authorization.

other: Host institution must be legally accredited in Lebanon.
Conditions depend on nationality.

routes.name: Free 3 month visa for Turkish citizens
routes.summary: Turkish citizens visiting as tourists get a free multiple-entry 3 month visa at the airport and border posts.

routes.name: 11 month visa for GCC residents (professionals)
routes.summary: Businessmen, directors, CEOs, doctors, engineers, lawyers and similar professionals who hold a residence permit in a GCC country get an 11 month visa at the airport or border. Wives and children need their own valid residence permit to get the same.

other: Family members without a GCC residence permit follow the rules for their own nationality.

routes.name: 1 month visa with funds check
routes.summary: Citizens of Algeria, Djibouti, Egypt, Comoros, Jordan, Libya, Morocco, Mauritania, Somalia, Sudan, Tunisia, Yemen, Ivory Coast, Ghana and Nigeria get 1 month, extendable to 3. They must show a return ticket, a hotel booking or address with phone number, and about 2,000 USD in cash or a certified check.

other: Egypt, Ghana, Nigeria and Ivory Coast also appear under prior-authorization rules on the same page, so confirm with General Security which applies to you.
Exempt if you hold a visa issued abroad by a Lebanese mission or General Security.
